description: This file defines the ErrorHandler class in the Slim framework, responsible for handling application errors, selecting appropriate response formats (JSON, XML, HTML, Plain Text), and logging errors as needed.

classes.name: ErrorHandler
classes.description: Default error handler for the Slim framework, responsible for rendering error responses in different formats and managing error logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies such as callable resolver, response factory, and optional logger.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main entry point for handling an error, determines response details and generates the error response.

methods.name: forceContentType
methods.description: Sets a forced content type for all error responses.

methods.name: determineStatusCode
methods.description: Determines the HTTP status code based on the exception and request method.

methods.name: determineContentType
methods.description: Selects the response content type based on the Accept header.

methods.name: determineRenderer
methods.description: Chooses the appropriate error renderer based on content type.

methods.name: registerErrorRenderer
methods.description: Registers a custom error renderer for a specific content type.

methods.name: setDefaultErrorRenderer
methods.description: Sets the default error renderer and content type.

methods.name: setLogErrorRenderer
methods.description: Sets the renderer used for error logging.

methods.name: writeToErrorLog
methods.description: Logs the error using the configured renderer.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Wraps the logger's error method for easier testing.

methods.name: getDefaultLogger
methods.description: Provides a default logger instance if none is supplied.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Builds and returns the error response based on current settings and exception.
